title: Saudi Arabian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by the cuisine of Saudi Arabia, featuring marinated chicken kebabs roasted to perfection in the oven.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and mix until they are well coated with the marinade.
Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto skewers, leaving a little space between each piece.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Roast the kebabs in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the chicken is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the kebabs from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
